insiders.methodology: Team and Investor allocations vested from a shared VestedEscrow contract that also held the Treasury allocation. Recipients and received amounts come from the escrow's Fund events (excluding the treasury); the escrow is fully vested and fully claimed, so funded amounts equal amounts received. Team and Investor wallets cannot be distinguished on-chain, so they are tracked as a single group. Staked amounts are current CVX balances in the cvxRewards staking pool and CVX locked in vlCVX.

Curve LP Rewards.methodology: CVX minted pro-rata for CRV claimed by Curve LPs on Convex (50% allocation)

curve-lp-mints.name: Curve LP Reward Mints
curve-lp-mints.methodology: Tracks CVX minted (Transfer from 0x0) when Curve LPs claim CRV rewards through Convex's Booster.

Staking Rewards.methodology: Tracks CVX rewards distributed to token holders through staking

staking-rewards.name: cvxCRV Staking Rewards
staking-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardPaid events from cvxCRV staking contract, excluding rewards sent to treasury. These rewards go to token holders who stake their cvxCRV.

Farming Incentives.methodology: CVX incentives distributed to LPs and external parties via MasterChef and Treasury

masterchef-farming.name: MasterChef LP Farming
masterchef-farming.methodology: Tracks CVX transfers from MasterChef to LP farmers and their reward pools, excluding the ChefRewardHook that routes to CvxDistribution staking and the one that routed CVX to the treasury.

treasury-distributions.name: Treasury Distributions
treasury-distributions.methodology: Tracks CVX transfers from the treasury, excluding MasterChef recycling.
